semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-purity gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shandong HuaYuTongFang Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-purity HCl and Cl2 gases, crucial for cleaning and etching processes in semiconductor fabrication. With over 20 years of experience, the company is expanding its product offerings to include additional specialty gases by 2026-2027.
capabilities: High-purity HCl gas for wafer cleaning and etching
Development and supply of etching chemicals

regional_presence.China: The company operates two manufacturing plants in China, focusing on the production and supply of specialty gases for the semiconductor industry.
